Infinite statement is proved from quantified inequalities, not inferred from finite enumeration.

value.rationale: PASS: Natural full classification of a metric-free affine-geometric invariant and its whole center locus across all finite polymatroid independence polytopes, not a selected numeric sample. A canonical maximum-density-tight set determines all rigid coordinates; residual packing polytope and uniform-density iff unique-center classification show a genuine structural/nonunique transition; the triangle-with-bridge yields a segment while U_{2,4} yields a unique center. This addresses a motivated invariant already studied for general convex bodies and connects it to standard matroid arboricity without claiming that known arboricity theorem is new.
